Messages.Author: hardyrange
Messages.Body:
Would a Banishment called successfully on a vampire who has a Priority Contract on him or her trigger the Priority Contract?

The banished vampire would be about to leave the ready region, so I could chose to burn the Priority Contract, right?

> Priority Contract
> Type: Master
> Requires: Assamite
> Unique contract. Trifle.
> Put this card on a minion controlled by your prey and choose a ready Assamite you control. The chosen Assamite can enter combat with this minion as a +1 stealth  action. If this minion would leave the ready region, you can burn this card to gain 3 pool.
>
> Banishment
> Type: Political Action
> Choose a younger ready vampire. Successful referendum means that the chosen vampire is moved to the uncontrolled region (breaking any temporary control effects). The vampire is uncontrolled. Any cards and counters on that vampire stay with him or her (but they are out of play as long as the vampire remains uncontrolled).
>
"It was a perfect plan - until it had contact with reality"
---
Hardy Range
Playgroup Tradition Compliance Manager
